text: Jewell Parker Rhodes' Ghost Boys was formally challenged in Humble ISD in September 2020 because the complainant said it included “negative stereotypes aimed at police”; a review committee found it appropriate. The Kingsburg (CA) Elementary Charter School District removed it from its curriculum after a parent complained about its political views, without going through a reconsideration process.
meta_description: Ghost Boys by Jewell Parker Rhodes: challenged in Humble ISD in September 2020 and kept; removed without review in Kingsburg, CA.
